biggest_catch: Zero guaranteed gigs: most testers receive 0-5 test invites a month, only a portion of applicants are selected for each test, and payment can be withheld if your work is judged low quality.
catches: No guaranteed tasks — the official terms state most users receive 0-5 User Research Test invites per month, with no guarantees.
Screening and qualification: only a portion of applicants are selected for each test, and invites depend on your profile.
Variable availability: test volume is driven by client demand and can be zero in some months.
Effective hourly pay can be low — $10-$20 per test with no steady hours or minimum income.
Unpaid entry work is possible: qualification/screening steps before selection are not paid.
Payment may be withheld if your submitted work is judged inadequate or low quality.
You supply your own devices and bear your own participation costs.
Rewards are redeemed through Tremendous, whose own terms and limits apply.

steps: Sign up as a participant on betatesting.com and complete your tester profile.
Browse User Research Tests and apply to the ones that fit you (only a portion of applicants are selected).
If selected, complete the test — typically screen and voice recording with tasks and feedback — and submit within the deadline.
Deliver high-quality, complete work, since payment can be withheld for inadequate work.
Redeem your earned rewards through Tremendous per the instructions in your participant account.
timing: No fixed platform-wide payout schedule published; earned rewards are redeemed through Tremendous.
